title: Who Owns Your Company's AI History?
summary: Most AI policies police what staff paste. The bigger 2026 exposure is whose account holds the work and what it can reach.
caption:
When an employee resigns, IT shuts off their email. The personal ChatGPT account holding two years of your proposals and pricing goes with them.
Most AI policies focus on what staff paste. In 2026 the larger exposure is whose account holds the work and what that account is allowed to reach.
Connected assistants generally work with the permissions a user already has. Years of quiet oversharing become searchable.
Banning the tools usually moves the work somewhere you cannot see. Owning the accounts, tying them to identity and approving connectors centrally does far more.
Our latest essay sets out the decision leadership actually needs to make.
